subject.title: Memory MVP: define SQLite schema and canonical record model

question: Should memory-core’s durable memory source of truth move from Markdown files to a plugin-owned typed SQLite record model for the MVP, and what v1 status, revision, provenance, and migration contract should it use?
rationale: The request defines a stored data model and upgrade boundary that affects memory ownership, migrations, provenance, review/forget flows, and sibling Memory MVP issues; automation should not choose that product contract alone.

options.title: Approve SQLite Record Contract
options.body: Define the v1 record/status/revision/provenance contract first, then implement the schema and migration boundary in memory-core.

options.title: Keep Markdown Canonical
options.body: Continue treating SQLite as retrieval/index infrastructure and narrow or close this schema request after documenting that direction.

options.title: Defer Until Memory Converges
options.body: Keep the issue as design backlog until maintainers choose the recommended memory plugin path called out in VISION.md.

recommendation.title: Approve SQLite Record Contract
recommendation.body: Define the v1 record/status/revision/provenance contract first, then implement the schema and migration boundary in memory-core.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans memory-core ownership, SDK boundary, and migration policy, and steipete has strong history on the current memory host and flush boundaries.
